classification.difficultyReason: Represent equal rod lengths with one pronumeral and subtract the overlap when forming the total-length equation.

content.prompt:
First introduce a pronumeral and then solve the equation.

The two rods $AB$ and $CD$ have the same length and overlap by 5 cm. Find the length of each rod.

spec.description: Equal horizontal rods AB and CD in separate rows, with endpoint order A, C, B, D. Dimension arrows show the total span of 55 cm and overlap of 5 cm. Dashed vertical guides preserve their associations. Source blue strokes and red endpoints are rendered black under house style because their colours do not encode distinct mathematical quantities.
spec.mathematics: AB = CD; overlap CB = 5 cm; total horizontal span AD = 55 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied endpoints and dimensions are visible; rod lengths remain unknown.

answer.worked:
Let $x$ cm be the length of each rod. Adding both lengths counts the overlap twice, so subtract 5 cm to obtain the total span.
$$\begin{align*}2x-5&=55\\2x&=60\\x&=30\end{align*}$$
Each rod is $30\text{ cm}$ long.

Check: $30+30-5=55\text{ cm}$.
